field.label: Server address
field.help: IPv4 address of the RADIUS server.

field.label: Shared secret
field.help: Stored secrets are never shown. Leave empty when editing to keep the current secret.

field.label: Authentication port
field.help: UDP port for Access-Request (0 disables authentication against this server).

field.label: Accounting port
field.help: UDP port for Accounting-Request (0 disables accounting against this server).

field.label: Priority
field.help: 0 is queried first; higher values act as fallback servers.
